newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's AIB raises variable lending rates.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's AIB raises variable lending rates.

text.p: Allied Irish Banks said on Wednesday that it was raising its standard variable mortgate rate and lending rates in general by 50 basis points.
Its business term loan is being increased by 25 basis points while deposit rates are being increased by between 25 and 50 basis points.
All changes take effect from the close of business on May 9, the bank said in a statement.
The move followed a 50 basis point rise in the official Short Term Facility Rate (STF) by the central bank on May 1.
